issues.before: Same owner/key/body on another KB, document or snapshot replayed the old resource job.
issues.after: Target IDs participate in canonical hashes; exact retries replay, cross-target reuse conflicts.

issues.before: GET job uses id, causing current.job_id loops to stop after queued/running.
issues.after: Both flows poll the immutable accepted job ID until terminal success/failure.
issues.red: Observed browser success cases called GET once instead of three times; failure cases missed errors.
issues.green: queued -> running -> succeeded/failed covered for both actions

issues.before: Only the first 50 documents were shown, with no next page.
issues.after: Metadata-aware pagination, replacement/deletion of document 101, last-page clamping and stale KB response fencing.
issues.red: Backend pagination metadata absent; browser count missing; stale page overwrote current KB.
issues.green: Real PostgreSQL and mobile browser 101-document cases passed.

limitations: No paid model calls or live public-web success validation in this repair.
Pre-fix receipt hashes fail closed with409; no unsafe legacy replay fallback.
Prior backup/restore and image evidence is retained from initial V1; these unchanged mechanisms were not re-exercised in this repair.
